From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Primary Vendor Record: legal entity confirmation & PO routing questionnaire

Hi Sara —

Thanks for agreeing to get Pioneer Components into our vendor system. To get the vendor master created and to ensure purchase orders and invoices route correctly, can you please confirm/upload the items below? I attached our short vendor intake form to make this easier.

Required for vendor master creation:
- Legal/registered name (exact as on tax docs)
- Tax ID (EIN or VAT #) and W-9/W-8 or local equivalent (PDF)
- Articles of incorporation or certificate of formation (PDF)
- Registered address and remit (billing) address if different
- Primary AP contact name, email, and phone (who receives POs and invoices)
- Preferred invoice file format (PDF/CSV/EDI) and invoice prefixing (PO#, invoice# mapping)

Operational details we capture:
- Bank name and last 4 of account for ACH mapping (we will validate via AP)
- Whether Pioneer has any subsidiary/legal entities that will invoice separately (if yes list legal names)
- Any required PO approvals or invoice coding instructions (project codes)

Attachments: vendor_intake_form.pdf (fillable)

If you can return the filled form plus copies of Articles/W-9 by EOD Friday (7/2), Monica in AP will kick off the master creation and map the PO routing. Feel free to paste answers inline if that’s easier.

Best,
David
David Kim
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
Email: david.kim@redwood-inference.com
Phone: (415) 555-0198

---
Note: Monica Patel (cc) will own the AP mapping; Kimberly Park (cc) is vendor operations and will help with any entity-name canonicalization questions.

Thanks — attaching the initial packet and a completed intake worksheet. Quick answers inline below and in the attached Excel:

- Legal/registered name: Pioneer Components, Inc.
- Tax ID: EIN XX-XXXXXXX (Full provided in attachment)
- W-9: attached as Articles_of_Incorporation.pdf and Pioneer_MASTER_INFO.xlsx contains W-9 fields
- Registered address: 415 Harbor Ave, Suite 220, San Mateo, CA 94404
- Remit address: same as registered address (no separate remit)
- AP contact: Sara Johnson (AP Manager) — sara.johnson@pioneercomponents.com — +1-650-555-3344
- Preferred invoice format: PDF attached to email; our portal can also export CSV for AR systems
- Invoice prefix: we do not require a custom prefix; please route PO# to invoice reference field

Subsidiaries: Pioneer distributes under a DBA (Pioneer Logistics LLC) but invoices to Redwood will come from Pioneer Components, Inc. only.

Thanks — I’ll return a signed packet after the small items are confirmed.

Sara —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and attachments, they look good. To answer your questions:

1) PO sender: purchases@redwood-inference.com (please whitelist that domain) — POs are also posted to our supplier portal, but you’ll receive an email copy.
2) Yes — we can issue a sandbox/test PO. Monica (cc) will generate a single $0 test PO with the PO# pattern you’ll see in production. After you confirm receipt and invoice mapping we’ll flip the vendor to active.

A couple of minor asks before we run the test:
- Can you confirm the last 4 of the bank account (for ACH match): 3344 (we only store last 4)
- Please confirm the name used for remittance on the ACH should be exactly: Pioneer Components, Inc.

Monica — when you have a moment can you create the vendor record in NetVendor and draft the sandbox PO to billing@pioneercomponents.com? Use the PO channel purchases@redwood-inference.com and set invoice routing to billing@pioneercomponents.com.

Kimberly — if you see any entity canonicalization issues in the spreadsheet (DBA vs legal), please flag and advise the naming to use in Redwood’s master (we prefer legal name + any DBA in parenthesis).

Thanks,
David
